utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to ask Madam Registrar to call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-02-54-T-R77.2, the Prosecutor versus Dusko Jovanovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I shall now ask the Prosecution to introduce himself or herself.

utterances.speaker: MS. ROMANO
utterances.text: Your Honour, Cristina Romano for the Prosecution, and with me is Milbert Shin and our case manager, Susan Grogan.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to ask the attorney of the accused to introduce himself, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SIMIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, my name is Sinisa Simic. I'm attorney from Belgrade, Defence counsel for the accused Dusko Jovanovic, editor-in-chief for the Montenegrin newspaper DAN.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I shall now ask the accused to stand up, please. Could you give me your first name and second name, please. And last name, sorry.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, my name is Dusko Jovanovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] When were you born?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On the 2nd of February, 1964, in Podgorica.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] What is your job?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have a degree in law, and now I am editor-in-chief of the weekly DAN.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Where do you live?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Podgorica, Montenegro.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Have you -- has the indictment been served on you and were you able to read this indictment in your own native language?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I have received the indictment, and I have read it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Did you understand the contents thereof?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have understood the contents.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Would you like the indictment to be read out to you or do you feel that you know what this indictment contains to the full?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There's no need for it to be read out. I have understood it fully.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Pursuant to Article 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, I have the obligation to check that you have an attorney to defend you, which is the case. As regards the indictment, you told me that you had read it. I must also let you know that within 30 days of the initial appearance, i.e. today, you will be asked whether you want to plead guilty or not guilty, but you can, if you so wish, plead guilty or not guilty today on the count you are charged with. Could you let me know what your position is, please? Would you like to settle for the 30-day delay or would you like to enter a plea today and state whether you enter a plea of guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I think I could enter a plea today already as to whether I feel guilty or not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And what do you decide to do?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't think it is so simple that I can answer with a guilty or not guilty. I think that in my case, there is objective responsibility because of my position as director and editor-in-chief of DAN, but no guilt in the intention to show contempt for the Court or to hurt a protected witness. And in order to explain the reasons, this would take a little more time, and I would need to consult with my counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. I shall draw the following conclusion: You plead neither guilty nor not guilty today. It is -- we are talking now about a plea of not guilty consequently, and pursuant to the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, pursuant to Article 62 bis, you have 30 days in which to stipulate your position. As you undoubtedly know, this case will come under the jurisdiction of Chamber III, and you will be notified in the next few days by the Registry of the date which will be set to start the proceedings pursuant to Article 62 bis. As we are today the 5th of December, 30 days from now, that will be the 5th of January. This Tribunal, however, only resumes on the 12th of January. Therefore, the date we will set for the said proceedings will be after the 12th of January. Does the Prosecution at this stage of the hearing have any arguments to submit?

utterances.speaker: MS. ROMANO
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. I shall now give the floor to the attorney of the accused. Sir, do you have any comments to make?

utterances.speaker: MR. SIMIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I would just like on behalf of my client, Mr. Dusko Jovanovic, to apologise for not appearing here yesterday. This was due to objective circumstances. We had not received a visa from the Kingdom of the Netherlands in due time, and that is why we did not appear yesterday, and we owe you an apology for this. We should also like, pursuant to the Rules of this Tribunal, to receive the material relating to the indictment presented today, the supporting material, in other words. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. I shall now turn to the Prosecution. Pursuant to Article 66 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, the Prosecution has the obligation to send within 30 days as of the date of the initial appearance copies of all the supporting material as well as any other documents. Can you confirm that this will be done in the given time frame?

utterances.speaker: MS. ROMANO
utterances.text: Your Honour, the supporting material is available immediately for the accused and the Defence, so we believe that right after the hearing we are ready to deliver.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. The Defence has just been informed of the fact that any documents will be handed over to them. Do you have any further questions? If not, I would like to thank all the parties present here today, and I declare this initial appearance hearing adjourned. And the Registry will let the Defence know about the next hearing date.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: Initial Appearance adjourned at 2.11 p.m.
